value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Tot Gym for 18 months-3.11 yrs, drop-in Thursdays 9:30-12, fall session Sept 10-Dec 16, $15 per visit - their site says. They also list a Preschool/Kinderfun drop-in (under 4) running Oct 9-June 26, though it doesn't post a price. Want me to check on that?
